title: Admin Course-Material Browser UI
description: The frontend module shall render a read-only course-material browser for any student, reachable from Course Oversight.
rationale: Admins must be able to inspect a student's full learning record (syllabus, sections, lesson content, homework, rubric, submissions, grades, and relevant chat messages) without any edit controls, to fulfil the read-only oversight mandate from root ask #3. Surfacing this from Course Oversight ensures the natural discovery path matches the admin's existing workflow.
